p: hand of the Philistines: So that they paid no more tribute.
two lines measured he to put: He slew two parts as it pleased him, and reserved the third.
Syria of Damascus: In that part of Syria, where Damascus was.
and brought gifts: They paid yearly tribute.
Jerusalem: For the use of the temple.
bless him: For seeing David victorious, he was glad to ask for peace.
judgment and justice unto all his: He gave judgment in controversies, and was merciful toward the people.
Cherethites and the Pelethites: The Cherethites and Pelethites were as the king's guard, and had charge of his person.
